title: Genome Browser
description: Explore lncRNA and regulatory data in an interactive genome browser powered by IGV.js. Navigate through chromosomes, view gene annotations, and analyze regulatory regions.
searchError: Failed to navigate to the specified location
noConfigDesc: The genome browser configuration for this species is not available. Please try another species or contact support.
geneLoadModeDesc: Enter a lncRNA gene name to load its genomic location and associated regulatory relationships. Only data related to this gene will be displayed.
speciesBrowseModeDesc: Browse the complete genome of the selected species. Navigate freely to any chromosome location and view genome-wide data.
remoteGenomeNoteDesc: This genome is loaded from UCSC servers. Initial loading may take a moment depending on your network connection.

conservationTracks.title: UCSC Multiz Conservation
conservationTracks.hint: Multiz-derived conservation scores (BigWig, local load via /genomes with HTTP Range).
conservationTracks.notAvailable: No local conservation BigWig found for this genome. Install the files in GENOMES_DIR to enable.
conservationTracks.saved: Display settings saved (will apply when the track is loaded).
conservationTracks.resetSaved: Display settings reset (will apply when the track is loaded).

tracks.repeatMaskerDesc: Display repeat elements in the genome (LINE, SINE, LTR, etc.)

repeatMaskerDisplayMode.label: Display Mode
repeatMaskerDisplayMode.squishedDesc: Compact view, multiple repeats per row
repeatMaskerDisplayMode.expandedDesc: Each repeat on its own row

chipseq.title: Epigenomic Tracks
chipseq.baselineGuide: Main-text baseline: 8 core histone marks + DNase-HS. Extended human tracks: CTCF and H4K20me1.
chipseq.prereqHint: Requires ChIP-seq data and a ready database schema; see docs/QUICKSTART_CHIPSEQ.md
chipseq.networkOrCorsHint: If you access the frontend via a LAN IP, ensure the backend allows this origin (CORS_ORIGINS includes {{origin}}) and the endpoint is reachable: {{url}}
chipseq.selectMarksHint: Select histone modifications or open chromatin assays to display as tracks
chipseq.noMarksAvailable: No epigenomic marks available for this species
chipseq.noMarksAvailableHint: If you've imported data but still see none, refresh stats/materialized views; see docs/QUICKSTART_CHIPSEQ.md
chipseq.schemaNotReadyDesc: Required ChIP-seq tables/views are missing (e.g., chipseq_* / epigenetic_mark_types / mv_chipseq_mark_stats). Initialize per docs/QUICKSTART_CHIPSEQ.md and retry.
